name: Sagamihara Yukiho
source:
A gentle and laid-back nurse with a calm atmosphere. It is said that she can soothes people hearts just from her presence and she is trusted by her peers for her competence in work.

She is married. However, two years prior to main story, she became a widow when her husband was involved in a traffic accident. Currently, she has accepted his death and become more positive about her job as nurse as she become more aware of how precious life is.

Because she is an attractive woman, many colleagues and patients approach her despite not being interested in remarriage. She is also quite popular among children as a mother figure such as making amigurumi as talismans for them before surgery.

Sexual preference : anal

[Summarized from [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/chikando/character.html]the official website[/url]]
